summary.headline: Divine Providence Over Astrology
summary.text: Theological argument that bodily weapons, horses, and worldly powers cannot ensure salvation without God, illustrated by David and Goliath, the Chaldean furnace, and Elijah’s water miracle. It argues that prayers and good deeds can avert evils predicted by mathematicians and that God may reverse hopeless outcomes beyond expectation, citing Paul and Scripture.
